grades.notes: Emporio Rulli's GR Chocolate line includes bars in dark chocolate (Nocciolata, Mandorlata, Biscoff); SFO page confirms the Terminal 1 Gate B13 shop, open 5am-10pm. Shop is past security, so only ticketed passengers can reach it. SFO page needed Chrome (WebFetch refused).
Off Kilter is a skateboard and tie-dye apparel shop; its site lists decks and shirts, no camping gear. Social posts place the shop in Ambler but one gives 300 Brookside Ave, not 22 N Main St.

Independent toy store at 4313 Upton Ave S (Facebook active with a seasonal post, signed-in content shown; Yelp lists current hours). Its own 2019 Facebook post features a book and jigsaw puzzle, a Dec 2024 blog praises its 'great selection of Jigsaw Puzzles', and Yelp ranks it a top puzzle store nearby.

ditrdone.com no longer resolves (DNS error). Western tack shop in Gill (horse winter blankets, saddle pads, roping gear per its Facebook); no evidence of wool blankets for people. Facebook page still active (undated egg-sale post; signed-in content shown), listings keep the Gill address.

Online wholesale linen supplier with no listed storefront (phone and email only). Its blanket pages describe wool as a fabric type but list only cotton, thermal and fleece blankets; 1334.8 mi with no address is not a local result.

HomeGoods all-stores list includes 400 Cochituate Rd, Framingham. The chain site only says stores carry cookware aisles (in-store only, no online catalog); shopper and press reports show Lodge cast iron skillets at HomeGoods, but stock varies by store.

Permanently closed: Hartford Courant (Dec 10, 2025) and Connecticut Scoop report Cookshop Plus closed at end of January 2026; Yelp and MapQuest mark it closed. Site fails with a TLS certificate mismatch.

Denver (1575 Boulder St) branch is announced but not yet open: Aug 21-28, 2026 articles say it 'will open' with no date. Site homepage returns 404; gift, toy, candy and home-goods shop with no evidence of wool blankets.

Kitchenwitch's own Facebook post announces a large Lodge cast iron shipment (post undated in search results); a listing notes the owner seasons cast iron in store. Site shows 671 Centre St with current hours.

Mollie Stone's delivery catalog lists many dark chocolate bars (Lindt 70%, Ghirardelli 72%, Hu, Chocolove), but for the site's default Mill Valley delivery zip, not Burlingame. Burlingame market page confirms 1477 Chapin Ave, open 7am-9pm.

Small independent grocery at 120 E Bluff St (Facebook shows the address and 'open now'; a Sep 2026 post says it was restocked). No product list anywhere; its listed site dsfoods.com now redirects to an unrelated Wisconsin caterer.

Boscov's catalog shows only a doll-size 'Sophia's Camping Tent' and tent-themed novelties, no real camping tents; its departments are apparel, home and kitchen. Location page confirms the Plymouth Meeting Mall store.
Trader Joe's national catalog lists several extra virgin olive oils (Premium EVOO, EVOO Liter, Sicilian Selezione). Location page confirms store 730 at 931 Monroe Dr.
Safeway's online catalog lists many dark chocolate bars (Hershey's Special Dark, Ghirardelli 72%/86%, Lindt Excellence), not checked for this store. Store page confirms 1450 Howard Ave, open 5am-2am.
Permanently closed: HomeGoods' all-stores list has no Allston store (only Downtown Crossing in Boston), and Yelp, MapQuest and Nextdoor mark 60 Everett St closed (one tracker says about Dec 2025).

Bunkline sells summer-camp supplies (camp blankets, sleeping bags, bedding, clothing, labels), not tents; the site lists phone numbers but no storefront. Listings conflict: 130 Ferry Ave, Camden (about 3.8 mi from 19103, matching the distance) vs 2060 Springdale Rd, Cherry Hill.

HomeGoods all-stores list includes the TJ Maxx/HomeGoods combo at Fresh Pond, 198 Alewife Brook Pkwy. Chain site only says stores carry cookware aisles; shopper reports show Lodge cast iron at HomeGoods, stock varies.

Tiesta's own catalog has a Green Tea category of loose-leaf teas. 1844 Brummel Ave shows up in listings and on its packaging, but one directory calls it a warehouse and the site names no retail shop, so walk-in sales are unconfirmed.

Ace's online catalog lists Energizer NiMH AA rechargeables and UltraLast solar AA rechargeables; Seneca stock not checked (would need changing the store selector). Store page confirms 255 S Main St, open 7 days.

Kosher butcher, deli and grocery ('one stop kosher shop') at 2153 Briarcliff Rd with current hours. Its online catalog covers only deli and butcher items (an olive oil search returns prepared dishes), so bottled EVOO is unconfirmed.
Gun shop and gunsmith (Yelp 'Guns & Ammo', BBB 'Gunsmiths'), no camping gear. Its site no longer resolves and FFLs.com shows its firearms license expired; Yelp still lists hours at 9280 Ridge Pike.

Homesense Framingham page (1 Worcester Rd, Shoppers World, open 9:30am-9:30pm) names a Kitchen & Dining department with cookware; cast iron specifically is not listed and stock rotates (TJX off-price model).

Small maker of lightweight mobile hunting blinds (not camping tents); its Shopify store shows 'Store unavailable'. 448 Pine Swamp Rd appears only as a vendor contact address, so no evidence of a walk-in shop.

Foot Locker's online catalog lists rain jackets (Nike Repel, Nike Storm-FIT, UA Storm); Natick Mall stock not checked, and stores are mainly footwear. Store page confirms 1245 Worcester St with current hours.

Likely permanently closed: Yelp lists 'Textile Fabric Store - CLOSED' at 471 Craighead St and the Squarespace site shows 'Website Expired'. The 1003 mi distance matches Nashville, but it is not a local result for 80622.

Lumber and hardware yard at 125 Sunderland Rd, open Mon-Fri 7am-5pm. Its partial online catalog (about 4,000 SKUs) and a Google site search show no cookware; a Google site search for cast iron found only a compressor.

Neighborhood grocery and deli; its own Instagram (in search snippet) lists Extra Virgin Olive Oil among items with olives, pickles and salami, and it advertises pantry staples. Site returned 403 to WebFetch but loaded in Chrome with current hours.

Small independent grocery at 120 E Bluff St (Facebook shows the address and 'open now'). No product list anywhere; dsfoods.com now redirects to an unrelated Wisconsin caterer, so loose-leaf green tea is unconfirmed.

Spirit Tea's own catalog lists nine loose-leaf green teas (Dragonwell, several senchas). Spirit Tea is an importer and wholesaler; 4200 W Diversey hosts events but no retail hours are published, so walk-in sales are unconfirmed.

Littleton store at 2479 W Main St is active (Facebook posts Aug-Sep 2026). Site homepage returns 404; it sells gifts, toys, candy and home goods, and a Google site search for blanket found only a candle, so wool blankets unconfirmed.

joepractice.com no longer resolves. Joe Practice is a boxing lessons and boxing gear business; directory listings keep 35 Harrison St, but there is no evidence of rain jackets or a current storefront.

jackssurplus.com redirects to Jack's DIY Home Store, a kitchen cabinet and building-surplus store; the Auburn branch at 139 S Front St is open Wed and Sat only. The site has no product list and no evidence of LED bulbs was found.

Weak chain evidence: a supplier's Instagram promotes Brio extra virgin olive oil tagged at Patel Brothers Suwanee, GA; Patel's online shop needs a store selected, so Decatur stock was not checked. Specials page confirms the Decatur store is active.
Wayfield's Instacart storefront lists Bertolli and Pompeian extra virgin olive oils, but not for this specific store. Wayfield's store picker confirms 3050-H Martin Luther King Jr Dr SW.

The Star Metal store's own Instagram (savi.starmetal) promotes Strippaggio olive oils, and Savi's Atlanta online shop lists California Olive Ranch and Alessi EVOO. The listed URL returns 404, but the locations page shows Star Metal at 1055 Howell Mill Rd with current hours.

The store's own site (420 Cool Springs Blvd, Franklin, with hours) has a 'Brio and Melissa & Doug' category and a 'Planes, Trains & Automobiles' interest, but its online catalog shows no wooden train set ('come in to see if we have it in store').

Electronics shop in Crown Center, Kansas City; its site lists power banks, chargers and cables but not rechargeable AA batteries ('Don't see it? Just ask'). At 351.7 mi, the distance matches Kansas City but this is not a local result for 61360.
